    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一天一个Python库：Matplotlib - 数据可视化的王者</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="引言">引言</h1>
<p>欢迎来到【一天一个Python库】系列！在上一篇中我们介绍了数值计算的基石 <strong>NumPy</strong>，<br>
今天我们要认识的是 Python 数据可视化领域中的王者 — <strong>Matplotlib</strong>。<br>
如果说 NumPy 负责“算数据”，那么 Matplotlib 就负责“把数据画出来”。</p>
<h1 id="一什么是-matplotlib">一、什么是 Matplotlib？</h1>
<p><strong>Matplotlib</strong> 是 Python 中最常用、最强大的二维（也支持部分三维）绘图库，<br>
它可以将数据以折线图、柱状图、散点图、饼图等多种形式直观地展示出来。</p>
<p>简单来说，Matplotlib 就是 Python 的“数据画笔”：</p>
<ul>
<li>能将抽象的数据转化为直观的图形，帮助我们理解数据；</li>
<li>支持高度自定义（标题、坐标轴、颜色、样式等）；</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="二matplotlib-的应用场景">二、Matplotlib 的应用场景</h1>
<p><strong>Matplotlib</strong> 广泛应用于以下场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><em>数据分析</em>：快速查看数据分布和趋势</li>
<li><em>机器学习</em>：绘制损失曲线、准确率变化</li>
<li><em>科研绘图</em>：生成高质量论文级图表</li>
<li><em>教学演示</em>：用图形辅助讲解数学和统计概念</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="三安装-matplotlib">三、安装 Matplotlib</h1>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>pip install matplotlib

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install matplotlib -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h1 id="四matplotlib-示例代码">四、Matplotlib 示例代码</h1>
<h2 id="1-绘制第一张折线图">1. 绘制第一张折线图</h2>
<pre><code class="language-python">import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# 准备数据
x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = np.sin(x)

# 创建图形
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(x, y, label='Sine Wave', color='blue', linewidth=2)

# 添加装饰
plt.title("My First Plot")
plt.xlabel("Time")
plt.ylabel("Amplitude")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)

# 显示图形
plt.show()
</code></pre>
<p><a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=import%20matplotlib.pyplot%20as%20plt%0Aimport%20numpy%20as%20np%0A%0A%23%20%E5%87%86%E5%A4%87%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%0Ax%20%3D%20np.linspace%280%2C%2010%2C%20100%29%0Ay%20%3D%20np.sin%28x%29%0A%0A%23%20%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E5%9B%BE%E5%BD%A2%0Aplt.figure%28figsize%3D%288%2C%204%29%29%0Aplt.plot%28x%2C%20y%2C%20label%3D'Sine%20Wave'%2C%20color%3D'blue'%2C%20linewidth%3D2%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%B7%BB%E5%8A%A0%E8%A3%85%E9%A5%B0%0Aplt.title%28%22My%20First%20Plot%22%29%0Aplt.xlabel%28%22Time%22%29%0Aplt.ylabel%28%22Amplitude%22%29%0Aplt.legend%28%29%0Aplt.grid%28True%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%98%BE%E7%A4%BA%E5%9B%BE%E5%BD%A2%0Aplt.show%28%29" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">在线运行此示例</a>  ，结果如下：</p>
<p><img alt="20251225_162245" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/70894/202512/70894-20251225163751616-1256047754.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>多图并排展示</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-python">import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

categories = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']
values = [15, 30, 45, 10]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

# 绘制柱状图
ax1.bar(categories, values, color='orange')
ax1.set_title('Bar Chart')

# 绘制散点图
ax2.scatter([1, 2, 3, 4], [10, 20, 25, 30], c='red')
ax2.set_title('Scatter Plot')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
</code></pre>
<p><a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=import%20matplotlib.pyplot%20as%20plt%0D%0A%0D%0Acategories%20%3D%20%5B'A'%2C%20'B'%2C%20'C'%2C%20'D'%5D%0D%0Avalues%20%3D%20%5B15%2C%2030%2C%2045%2C%2010%5D%0D%0A%0D%0Afig%2C%20%28ax1%2C%20ax2%29%20%3D%20plt.subplots%281%2C%202%2C%20figsize%3D%2810%2C%204%29%29%0D%0A%0D%0A%23%20%E7%BB%98%E5%88%B6%E6%9F%B1%E7%8A%B6%E5%9B%BE%0D%0Aax1.bar%28categories%2C%20values%2C%20color%3D'orange'%29%0D%0Aax1.set_title%28'Bar%20Chart'%29%0D%0A%0D%0A%23%20%E7%BB%98%E5%88%B6%E6%95%A3%E7%82%B9%E5%9B%BE%0D%0Aax2.scatter%28%5B1%2C%202%2C%203%2C%204%5D%2C%20%5B10%2C%2020%2C%2025%2C%2030%5D%2C%20c%3D'red'%29%0D%0Aax2.set_title%28'Scatter%20Plot'%29%0D%0A%0D%0Aplt.tight_layout%28%29%0D%0Aplt.show%28%29" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">在线运行此示例</a> ，结果如下：</p>
